title: Ram Kumar @ Virat Kaharwar @ Gullu v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Kshitij Shailendra, JJ.
disposition: Petition disposed; 15 days to object; clause 6.8 to be followed.
headnote: Writ petition challenging a notice of provisional assessment in an alleged electricity-theft case disposed of. Fifteen days' further time granted to file an objection. Respondent No. 4 to decide it in accordance with law, duly following clause 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No final assessment had yet been passed.
facts: Ram Kumar alias Virat Kaharwar alias Gullu petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others, challenging a notice of provisional assessment dated 16 August 2023 issued by respondent No. 4 for alleged theft of electricity. On 13 March 2024 none appeared for him and the matter was put up as fresh. On 21 March 2024 counsel for the Electricity Department stated that no final assessment order had yet been passed.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the provisional assessment notice dated 16.08.2023 is disposed of by granting fifteen days' further time to file an objection, if any. Respondent No. 4 shall then decide that objection in accordance with law, and the procedure prescribed under clause 6.8 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 shall be duly followed. No order of final assessment had yet been passed.

principle_tags.application: The Court granted fifteen days' further time to file an objection against the notice of provisional assessment, to be dealt with under clause 6.8.
The writ was disposed of without examining the alleged theft, leaving any objection to be decided by respondent No. 4 in accordance with law under clause 6.8.
The Court directed that the procedure prescribed under clause 6.8 shall be duly followed while deciding the objection and proceeding to final assessment.

not_decided.point: Whether the provisional assessment dated 16.08.2023 for alleged theft of electricity is sustainable
not_decided.note: No final assessment had been passed. Any objection filed within fifteen days is left to respondent No. 4 to decide in accordance with law.
